annotations.title: Get the setup steps for a client

description: Get the steps that connect one AI client to OnlyMCP: where to create the account, and the exact address, command or configuration file that client needs. Meant for helping a person set OnlyMCP up in a client they name; not for general questions about the product. Answers the steps as markdown with the configuration to copy; a token appears as the placeholder omk_…, never a real one. It sets nothing up itself, and the account's own endpoint (https://only-mcp.com/api/mcp) still needs the person to sign in.

client.description: The client to connect, by its id, for example claude-code, cursor or chatgpt.

language.description: Language of the answer: en (default), de, fr or it. A page not yet translated comes back in English.
